name: Amanda
message: Sending love and strength, Tango and family! We’re here for anything you may need!

name: Diane
message: Tango, I loved it when you would visit us in the office to play! Your strength was incredible. I hope your strength carry's you through this difficult time. Be well my friend.

name: Kevin and Karen
message: We are keeping Tango in our prayers for a healthy recovery. Thank you for your loyal service and hard work for the community. Much love!

name: Ken
message: I am honored to have met Tango and his partner/handler and his family. Thank you all for your dedication and service to our community. Good job Tango & family. Tango & his family helped our community, now it's time for our community to step up and help Tango.

name: Kyle
message: Tango, you spent six years keeping our community safe, and now we’re all in your corner. Rest easy, be spoiled, and know how many people are pulling for you. Thank you for everything, good boy.
